title: Reports Made-1945 During Japanese Occupation - Re - Death Of Prisoners Who Were Detained In The Detention House

Station Foreign Affairs Sect. File No. Date 19-2-44

FILE
批華文報告送上

SUBJECT: Re Death of prisoners who were detained in the Detention House at 285 Rue Massenet.

On instruction of the Officer in-charge of Foreign Affairs, the undersigned at 2 p.m. on 15-2-44, proceeded to the Detention House at 285 Rue Massenet, with a view to solicit some information re the death of prisoners who were detained therein, however with abortive results. The undersigned then proceeded to the Lokawei Station, where Sub-Inspector Marson was interviewed and the following informations were obtained:-

事由：关于在马思南路285号拘留所内被拘禁囚犯死亡一事。

奉外事主管官员之命，具报人于1944年2月15日下午2时前往马思南路285号拘留所，旨在索取有关在该处被拘禁囚犯死亡之信息，但未获结果。随后具报人前往卢家湾巡捕房，会见了副督察长马森（Marson），并获得如下信息：-
